mechanism: Establish one original clearly adult climber as a small readable figure against a single overwhelming vertical objective. Alternate environmental scale views with tactile close evidence of at least three different load-bearing contacts such as tool bite, foot placement and rope tension. Introduce one recoverable contact failure that visibly lowers or rotates the adult, then show the arrest and a new valid placement in the same geography before ascent continues. Preserve at least three equipment and costume anchors throughout. Cross the final ridge in close view, then release into one stable wide that proves summit arrival and completed scale without celebration. The reusable mechanism is scale objective, tactile contact evidence, one recoverable failure, continuity-bearing equipment, ridge crossing and summit-scale release—not the source woman, face, clothing, ice axes, mountain, K2 claim, exact stunt, camera, creator identity or timing.
